title: sorghum elongatum
intro: Sorghum elongatum, commonly known as Indian juncus, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures to harness its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum elongatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
